n: Notes for María – CTA options A and B

ch.n: CTA option A: scroll to form
ch.txt: CTA option A: scroll to form

ch.n: Every 'Submit your application' button scrolls smoothly to the form at the bottom. The form gets a short highlight when the visitor lands.
ch.txt: Every 'Submit your application' button scrolls smoothly to the form at the bottom. The form gets a short highlight when the visitor lands.

ch.n: CTA option B: form in a modal
ch.txt: CTA option B: form in a modal

ch.n: Buttons open the form on top of the page, so visitors keep their place. On mobile it becomes a full-screen sheet. The form also stays on the page for SEO.
ch.txt: Buttons open the form on top of the page, so visitors keep their place. On mobile it becomes a full-screen sheet. The form also stays on the page for SEO.

ch.n: A + Simple to build, works the same on every device; visitor sees the whole process on the way down
ch.txt: A + Simple to build, works the same on every device; visitor sees the whole process on the way down

ch.n: A – Visitor loses their place; long scroll on mobile
ch.txt: A – Visitor loses their place; long scroll on mobile

ch.n: B + Visitor keeps their place and can apply from anywhere, also from the floating button
ch.txt: B + Visitor keeps their place and can apply from anywhere, also from the floating button

ch.n: B – Form must still exist on the page for SEO and visitors without JavaScript
ch.txt: B – Form must still exist on the page for SEO and visitors without JavaScript
